findings.evidence: unassign on a SCHEDULED session calls registrationRepository.deleteBySessionIdAndStudentPublicIdInAndStatus(..., ENROLLED) for every current class member and then deletes the source. requireAssignable only checks status in {SCHEDULED, DRAFT}. HEAD SessionClassAssignmentService.requireScheduled also rejected sessions with generationJobPublicId != null (ExamAudienceLockedException); that discriminator is gone, so wizard-published sessions (which now carry CLASS sources) can be edited through /sessions/{id}/classes.
findings.why_it_matters: EnrollmentService.unenroll refuses a student who already started (EnrolledStudentAlreadyStartedException) and the roster is otherwise editable only via requireManualAudienceMutationAllowed; the class-unassign path bypasses the started-attempt guard, drops recorded attendance and identity state, and also removes a student still covered by another PROGRAM or STUDENT source of the same session (possible now that sources are unified).
findings.required_action: In the SCHEDULED branch of unassign, reuse the started-attempt check used by unenroll and skip students still resolved by another remaining source; or restrict SCHEDULED mutation on /classes to CLASS sources created by this endpoint. Add a test for each case.
findings.verification: Re-read: unassign now uses removableMembers (excludes students covered by other sources via AudienceResolver.resolveSource and students with started attempts); tests unassignOnScheduledExam_* present.

findings.evidence: ExamPublishService.generate (new synchronous AssessmentService.generateDeterministic path replacing ExamFormProvisioningService, with READY replay and DRAFT to READY transition) has no test: ExamWorkflowServicesTest has no generate/generation test and ExamFormProvisioningServiceTest was deleted. No test asserts the retention anchor (session.getClosesAt() passed to IdempotencyKeyService.begin, expiry closesAt + 90 days) from phase constraint (b), and AuditHistoryReader plus the new AuditLogRepository finder have no test (history is only tested with a mocked reader).
